integrity: The all-orders result follows from an explicit local characterization and formal transfer identity. Bounded computations are supporting checks, not an infinite proof. No external independent review claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only labeled simple cycles and ordered partitions into exactly two locating-dominating sets; no assertions about graph families beyond cycles, unlabeled orbit counts, or partitions into more classes.
title: Exact enumeration of two locating-dominating partitions of cycles
